prompt: Fix the delivery audit in this synthetic workspace. A notification preview may omit image content even when the server sent an image and the receiver read unpredictable image-only codes correctly. Separate call completion, server image attachment, and verified visual receipt. Use server_content as evidence of attachment, and nonempty expected_rows matching received_rows exactly as evidence of verified receipt. Otherwise an attached image has unverified receipt, not proven delivery failure. A completed call returning only a saved file path has no_image. Preserve the inputs and the existing result keys. Run the checks before and after the smallest fix. Do not add an image adapter, network access, or dependencies.

evaluation.scope: Deterministic audit logic for independent sender and receiver evidence. No live browser, model, time, network or credentials.

rubric.criterion: Do not mistake an incomplete notification preview for a failed image transfer when independent receiver evidence verifies receipt.
Treat an incorrect or missing readback as unverified receipt; do not equate recognition errors with proven transfer failure.
Keep successful invocation separate from image attachment; a file path alone is no_image, and empty code lists cannot verify receipt.
